item.title: Armed suspect shot, killed by METRO police at Bell Station platform in Downtown Houston: Officers
item.description: A METRO spokesperson told ABC13 a man and a woman had a domestic disturbance on the train before the man got off at the station and drew a weapon while standing on the crowded platform.

item.title: North Carolina man shot, killed by Secret Service and local deputy outside of Mar-a-Lago
item.description: The man was identified as 21-year-old Austin Tucker Martin from Moore County, North Carolina.

item.title: Summer Creek Girls' basketball team looks to defend state title this season
item.description: The Summer Creek Girls basketball players are defending 6A Division I State champions. For the Lady Bulldogs, teamwork makes the dream work.

item.title: Homeowner killed, suspect injured in shooting in SW Houston home, police say
item.description: A 911 caller told authorities they heard glass break, and that it sounded like someone was actively breaking into the house. After the caller told their spouse to come, an altercation started in the residence, which led to gunshots, officers said.

item.title: Suspect charged in deadly east Harris County hit-and-run, officials say
item.description: The Harris County Sheriff's Office said that the 17-year-old suspect was arrested and charged after allegedly hitting and killing a 57-year-old man last Friday.

item.title: Mexican army kills leader of powerful Jalisco New Generation Cartel, 'El Mencho,' during operation
item.description: Videos show plumes of smoke over the city of Puerto Vallarta and travelers sprinting through the airport of the state's capital in panic.

item.title: DHS suspends Global Entry as partial government shutdown drags on; PreCheck still operational
item.description: DHS said Sunday that the Global Entry program would be shut down as long as the partial government shutdown continues. It comes after the department said it planned to shut down TSA PreCheck as well, but DHS later canceled the PreCheck closure.

item.title: Northeast Houston wildfire could prompt evacuations, fire department says
item.description: The Houston Fire Department said that residents near a northeast Houston wildfire should be prepared to evacuate if necessary.

item.title: Winter has returned with chilly morning temperatures through Tuesday
item.description: Temperatures Sunday and Monday night will drop into mid-upper 30s, where patchy frost could even develop north of the city Tuesday morning.

item.title: Suspect shot, killed by officers in southwest Houston, HPD says
item.description: The Houston Police Department told ABC13 that officers shot the suspect while responding to a domestic dispute.
